tagline: 宾得数码单反相机，2006 年发布
description: 宾得于2006年推出的数码单反相机。配备Interchangeable Pentax KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode.。快门速度1/4000 sec–30 sec。

specs.传感器: Interline/interlace CCD with a primary color filter. APS-C 23.5 x 15.7 mm
specs.镜头: Interchangeable Pentax KAF2 mount compatible with Pentax auto-aperture lenses; older lenses supported in stop-down metering mode.
specs.曝光测光: TTL open-aperture metering with choice of: 16-segment, Center-weighted & Spot meter
specs.电池: Rechargeable D-LI50 Lithium-ion battery, Optional AC adapter
specs.重量: 710 g (25 oz) without battery, 785 g with battery
